title: Triage Report
description:
What sent the build back, as specialist work: the failures of the gates that judged the current build (and the typed findings a person gave at G4) normalized into quality findings (shared/quality-finding.schema.json), grouped by the specialist that owns each dimension, and the one group this visit routes.

The triage step sits between the gates and the work. A gate that fails a build, and G4's iterate, route to it; it routes on by the owner of the findings - `design` when the design must state a scope or content increase first, `assets` when an asset must be made again, and otherwise the specialist's own label, which the workflow maps to `develop` (core/workflows/new-game.workflow.yaml). The develop visit it routes is that specialist's: its brief carries only the selected group's findings, the specialist's craft playbooks and its writable scope (core/roles/roles.yaml). Groups of the same build that are not this visit's are `pending`: the develop step returns `next-specialist` and the next triage routes the next group, in core/reference/specialist-routing.yaml `order`, before the gates measure the build again.

`ledger` is the record per specialist visit: the findings it was given, the session cost develop recorded, and what the producer that raised each finding measured on a later build - resolved, unresolved, or not yet measured. A human finding is re-measured by the person at the next G4.

entered_by.description: The entry that brought the run to this triage, `<source>.<route>` (verify.fail, visual-qa.develop, prototype-review.iterate, assets.success, develop.next-specialist).

source.description: The gate entry the findings came from: entered_by for a fresh triage, carried unchanged through a chain of specialist visits (develop.next-specialist) and an assets pass the triage itself routed.

mode.description: fresh: the findings were normalized from the current build's failing reports. continued: the previous triage's pending groups, routed on. first-pass: entered by ordinary progression with nothing failing - the run's first build.

commit.description: The build the findings were measured on: the newest prototype-report's commit.

groups.description: Every group of this build's findings, in visit order.

selected.description: The group this visit routes; null when nothing is routed (first-pass, or every finding held).

pending.description: Groups after `selected`, routed by the next triages of this chain.

deferred.description: Groups dropped because a design route was taken: the design changes first, and the gates measure the rebuilt game again.

held.description: Findings no route of this loop can take - store copy before the listing exists - with why.

ledger.description: One entry per specialist develop visit of this run, oldest first.

lifecycle.description: The run's finding ledger: every finding any triage of this run has seen, with its status (detected, classified, assigned, implemented, verified, closed), every transition, and the verification evidence - carried from each triage-report to the next, so the newest one is the run's ledger. A finding is verified or closed only on the re-measurement of the producer that raised it, never on the specialist's report.

lesson_candidates.description: Added in 1.2.0. The lesson candidates of the specialist visits this triage read (prototype-report specialist.lesson_candidates), carried forward from the run's previous triage-report: surfaced to the quality gate and the person deciding G4, never applied by themselves.

verdict.description: routed: `selected` names the route this visit takes. clear: nothing failed (the first pass). held: findings exist and no route of this loop can take any of them - the run stops for a person.

label.description: The route label the triage step returns for this group, which the workflow's `on:` maps to a step.

playbooks.description: The craft playbooks the specialist reads (core/roles/roles.yaml `reads`).

writable_paths.description: The specialist's writable scope (roles.yaml `writes`), intersected by develop with the installation's writable paths.

prototype_report.description: The artifact id of the prototype-report the visit produced.

prototype_seq.description: Run-local production order of that prototype-report: a report produced after it re-measures the visit.

unmeasured.description: Not yet re-measured by the producer that raised it (a human finding waits for the next G4).

cost_usd.description: Developer session cost of the visit, as develop recorded it; null when unknown.
